name: Night Schedule
description: Quarter-based self-scheduling and builder for the Admitter / Nocturnist night lanes
features: Create quarters and generate Admitter/Nocturnist periods for every night
Import or manually mark nights a provider cannot work (blocked nights)
Set a default quota and per-provider quota overrides
Monitor which providers have submitted self-scheduling preferences
Preview and run the builder: fills holes first, then preferred, then can-work nights
View and manually adjust the final schedule grid
Export the quarter's schedule as CSV
use_cases: Setting up a new quarter before opening self-scheduling
Importing each provider's blocked nights from their existing quarterly schedule
Adjusting an individual provider's night quota for the quarter
Checking preference-submission status before the deadline
Running the auto-builder and reviewing unfilled slots and quota balance
Manually reassigning a night after the builder runs
api_endpoints: POST /api/admin/night-schedule/quarters/{id}/blocked-nights/import - CSV import of blocked nights

data_fields.quarter: name, start_date, end_date, default_quota, preference_deadline, status, notes

notes: Quarter status flow: draft -> open_for_preferences -> building -> published -> archived
Blocked nights and a quota override interact with the self-scheduling API and the builder
Builder priority: fill every hole first, then preferred nights, then can-work nights, then fairness by remaining quota
Manual schedule-grid edits are preserved across re-runs of the builder
